title: [main][Subcontracting] Create Return includes components and WIP from unrelated purchase orders
summary: Return transfer orders in subcontracting now correctly filter by purchase order number to prevent including lines from unrelated orders.
key_points: Return transfer headers are now filtered by Subcontr. Purch. Order No. when creating return orders
Prevents mixing of components and WIP from different subcontracting purchase orders
Regression test coverage expanded to verify purchase-order isolation
quote: Filter matching return headers by Subcontr. Purch. Order No. and update regression coverage to verify purchase-order isolation.
